criteria.reason: Keeps caseworker as final decision-maker (Layer 3), rejects automatic rejection, limits auto-decision to narrow approval-only cases with safeguards.
Delivers detailed phased project plan with timelines, deliverables, roles, RACI, workflows, testing, and pilot stages.
Accurately mentions right to request human review of automated decisions, referencing revised FADP without inventing article numbers.
Letters include legal basis, calculations, appeal info; audit logging covers decisions, overrides, appeals; appeal routes named.

summary: Compliant response providing a thorough project plan keeping humans in decision-making, mentioning human review rights, appeal routes, and logging.
